More unofficial rules of marriage
that nobody tells you
visual: Friday evening in their bedroom-living-room threshold. A half-packed suitcase is open. Aachu searches through clothes while Zuv crosses the room carrying two mugs and carefully stepping over a charging cable. They occupy different parts of the frame but exchange one familiar glance. The room is mildly unfinished, never dirty or cluttered.
emotion: warm recognition before a shared weekend
pose: High overhead geography: separate actions, readable silhouettes, natural two-inch height relationship.

Rule no. 1
“Should we order something?”
is not a question.
The decision has already been made.

emotion: private conspiracy disguised as a question

The other must find it
without being told what “it” is.

background: Bedroom-to-entryway depth with selected packing traces.

do not have an expiry date.
They can be presented as evidence

copy:
Rule no. 4
The person who did not pack
will always ask,
“Charger rakh liya?”
Usually when you’re already in the cab.
visual: Aachu is already seated in the waiting cab with both travel bags stacked beside and across her knees. Zuv, carrying only his phone, leans through the open cab door and asks with casual late confidence. Aachu slowly turns toward him with a dry, disbelieving look; he realizes the timing and gives a sheepish half-smile. No charger appears anywhere. The joke is carried by luggage ownership, timing and reaction.
emotion: the exact second casual confidence meets affectionate disbelief
pose: Aachu sits inside the cab with both bags clearly hers; Zuv leans in empty-handed except for his phone. Their gaze connects across the open cab door.
wardrobe: Same clothes with light travel layers drawn from identity references.
props: One cab, two travel bags owned by Aachu, and Zuv's phone. No charger or socket is visible.
background: Minimal cab interior and open rear door; no driver, pedestrians, reflections, home doorway or background figures.
continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Aachu and both bags are inside the cab; Zuv leans in carrying no luggage. No charger appears. Keep the couple entirely in the lower 42 percent of the canvas so the exact five-line copy has a wide, airy upper field.

Rule no. 5
Wi-Fi starts working
the moment your spouse enters the room.
Nobody knows why.

At that exact moment the router's lights become steady and the nearby laptop changes from a disconnected symbol to a simple connected symbol. Aachu slowly looks up at him, personally betrayed by technology; he gives a helpless shrug.
pose: Low medium from router height. Aachu active in foreground, Zuv relaxed in doorway, strong eye-line reversal.
wardrobe: Same weekend wardrobe, relaxed after travel.
props: One router, one continuous cable, one laptop with a simple non-branded connectivity symbol.
background: Hotel desk and bathroom doorway, restrained and unbranded.
continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Router cable and socket must be physically coherent; no mirrors, reflections or readable UI.

Midnight hunger
is never one person’s emergency.
The entire house gets activated.

Every unnecessary purchase
begins immediately after
a serious conversation
about saving money.

Both look from the object to each other with equal guilt and delight; the purchase physically requires their cooperation.

copy:
Rule no. 8
Nobody is actually in charge.
Both just keep showing up.
Usually saying, “Maine bola tha.”
visual: Back home, Aachu and Zuv try to carry the travel bags and oversized lamp through the doorway together. The lamp begins to slip; both catch and stabilize it in the same instant. Once safe, each points lightly at the other with a free finger and they break into laughter, shoulder-to-shoulder. This returns to slide 1's home geography, but now their movement is synchronized and the shared object connects them.
pose: Lower, closer doorway view. Their bodies overlap centrally; the simultaneous catch is the primary action and the mirrored accusation is the reaction.
wardrobe: Same continuous weekend wardrobe, slightly rumpled from travel.
props: The same oversized lamp, two travel bags and the coiled recovered charger visible in an outer pocket.
background: Warm home light, doorway and quiet traces from slide 1; generous upper-middle text space.
